recipe.visualDefinition: A retro album cover composition featuring a central vertical rectangular photograph framed by a thick, solid black border. The typography is stacked at the top, utilizing contrasting styles of a multi-line inline font and a bold, solid geometric sans-serif, with a minimalist logo mark at the bottom center.
coreVisualRelationships: Central vertical photo inset against a dominant black field
Top-heavy typographic hierarchy with tight leading
Color coordination between the sage green text and natural foliage tones
Symmetrical balance along the vertical axis
coreInvariants: Stacked centered typography at the top
Minimalist geometric icon at the bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject is centered horizontally, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, sage-green bold text acts as the primary visual anchor due to its weight and color contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, moves down through the central photograph, and rests on the bottom logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black negative space surrounds the central elements, creating a 'window' effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Solid black background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Sage green for primary text, echoing the natural greens in the photo.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/light grey for secondary inline text and logo details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, natural saturation in the photo contrasts with the flat, high-value solid colors of the text.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the main title
Multi-line inline etching for the secondary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a decorative inline texture and a solid, heavy geometric weight.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Bold or ITC Avant Garde
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and sharp vertices of the primary text.
Provides the multi-line internal texture for the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black square canvas. In the center, place a vertical rectangular photograph of a man in a brown jacket looking upward against a background of trees and blue sky. The photo should have a slightly grainy, 1960s film aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered uppercase text at the top. The first line should be in an inline sans-serif font in off-white. The second line should be a large, bold geometric sans-serif in sage green. Add a small circular geometric logo at the bottom center in off-white.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure solid black?
Is the photo a vertical rectangle centered in the frame?
Does the green text match the foliage in the photo?
Are the fonts uppercase and sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Hue of the green accent text

mustAchieve: Authentic 60s film grain in the photo
avoid: Rounded corners on the photo frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the inline font lines are distinct and not blurred.
Verify the black background is uniform and lacks noise.
Confirm the photo does not bleed to the edges of the canvas.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid black frame + Vertical photo window + Stacked geometric/inline type + Bottom-centered icon.
